package.name: Saucelings
package.description: A Tamagotchi-style pet in Home: pick a character to look after an egg, let their personality drive their care schedule, cover the gaps they miss, watch its sauce temperament shift, retire elders to a Menagerie, and let the caretaker find eggs of their own invention while you chat. Install it, restart Marinara Engine when prompted, then open Home → Saucelings.
